<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD is safe for the narrow gate of `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. Both sources in the `source` array point to the project's own upstream resources on GitHub (`thewh1teagle/vibe`): the `.deb` binary release and the `LICENSE-MIT` file from the main branch. Both sources have explicit SHA256 checksums (not SKIP), so they will be verified upon download. There is no `pkgver()` function defined, and no commands exist in the top-level scope that would execute during sourcing — only variable declarations. No use of `eval`, `base64`, `curl`, `wget` in dangerous contexts, or any obfuscated code. The `package()` function contains only standard installation operations, but it will not execute due to `--nobuild`. This is standard AUR packaging for a prebuilt binary distribution.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>No malicious code detected; sources are from project's own upstream with verified checksums.</summary>
</security_assessment>
